title: GTA 6's Original Soundtrack Features French Duo Justice
description: A leaked song suggests GTA 6's original soundtrack will be incredible, with French electronic duo Justice reportedly producing an entirely new score.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Set to Impress with Justice

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the next chapter in Rockstar Games' iconic franchise, new details continue to surface regarding what players can expect from the world of GTA 6. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, Rockstar Games is going all-out for the highly anticipated title, and that dedication extends directly to its original soundtrack.

### Electronic Duo Justice Joins the Project

Alongside the extensive lineup of licensed music that players will undoubtedly hear while cruising through the game's world, an entirely new score is reportedly being produced by Justice, the renowned French electronic duo. Known for their distinct electronic soundscapes and high-energy tracks, Justice's involvement suggests that the sonic landscape of GTA 6 will be nothing short of extraordinary. Industry observers note that Rockstar's commitment to curating top-tier audio experiences has always been a series hallmark, and collaborating with artists of this caliber raises the bar even higher.

### Elevating the Open-World Experience

Music has always played a vital role in defining the atmosphere of the Grand Theft Auto universe. By investing in an original score crafted by professional electronic musicians alongside traditional licensed radio tracks, Rockstar is ensuring a deeper level of immersion for players. Whether navigating tense mission sequences or simply exploring the open world, these new compositions will likely add a distinct emotional weight to the gameplay. While full details remain to be seen, if this leaked song is any indication, the overall audio package of GTA 6 is shaping up to be phenomenal.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar has always treated music as a core pillar of the GTA experience. Bringing in Justice for an original score proves they are pushing creative boundaries. It's a massive win for both electronic music fans and gamers alike.
